name: Sigma-shift self guidance
plain: Runs cond a second time with the same latent at a different sigma, and adds the difference between the two predictions. No attention is perturbed; the perturbation is just a wrong timestep. The sg_prev mode gets a similar term free from the previous step's cond prediction.
math: x̂+=w(x̂_c(σ)−x̂_c(σ′)). σ′=σ(1+a), σ+a, σ+σ_max/a, previous σ, or σ(1+σ/a); clamped to the model range. sg_prev: x̂+=w(x̂_c−x̂_c,prev), no extra call.
